modules.module_title: Prepare materials for Ceramic toy making

pcs.pc_description: Identify and select appropriate raw materials, such as clay, glazes, and pigments, for ceramic toy making.
Check the quality of raw materials to ensure they are free from impurities and meet required standards.
Measure and mix the clay and other additives in the correct proportions to achieve the desired consistency.
Knead and condition the clay to remove air bubbles and improve workability.
Organize and prepare tools, molds, and work surfaces for the ceramic toy-making process.
Select the appropriate shaping technique, such as hand molding, slip casting, or wheel throwing, based on the toy design.
Use molds or hand tools to shape the toy, ensuring accurate dimensions and design details.
Smooth and refine the surface of the toy using appropriate tools to achieve a clean finish.
Leave the shaped toys to dry under controlled conditions to prevent cracks or warping.
Apply decorative elements, such as carving, engraving, or painting, to enhance the aesthetic appeal of the toy.
Use glazes or underglazes to add color, texture, or patterns to the toy’s surface.
Ensure even application of decorative elements to maintain uniformity.
Inspect the toy for any imperfections and make necessary corrections before firing.
Preheat the kiln and set the appropriate temperature for firing the ceramic toys.
Load the toys into the kiln carefully, ensuring proper spacing to avoid damage during firing.
Monitor the firing process and adjust settings as required to achieve the desired hardness and finish.
Inspect the fired toys for defects, such as cracks, uneven surfaces, or glaze imperfections.
Test the durability and safety of the toys, ensuring they meet quality and safety standards.
Package the ceramic toys using appropriate materials to prevent damage during storage or transportation.
Label the packaged toys with details such as product name, batch number, and handling instructions.

modules.module_title: Prepare required raw materials to make terracotta toy

pcs.pc_description: Arrange raw materials and tools at workplace like ball clay, mud clay, black clay, chisel, fine pen etc. for making terracotta toy.
Prepare collected clay by breaking down solid pieces of mud and blend it with water by using appropriate tools like, blender, hammer, etc.
Sieve the blended mixture using sieve of fine mesh to remove tiny stone pieces.
Air dry sieved mixture for two days to make it of right consistency.

modules.module_title: Perform the standard process of terracotta toy making

pcs.pc_description: Place a lump of clay mixture on the turning wheel to make terracotta toy.
Provide shape like doll, animal or any desirable shape to the clay mixture on the turning wheel.
Cut off the clay from the turning wheel using string of thread and keep it for drying.
Provide shape and details to the toy by using tools like chisel, knife, pointed tool, etc.

modules.module_title: Perform the standard process of baking terracotta toy

pcs.pc_description: Place the prepared toy in open air for sun drying for 2 days.
Preheat the kiln at appropriate temperature using wood as fuel to burn the toys to give them strength.
Place the toys in preheated kiln to be burnt for three hours.

modules.module_title: Check toy quality and productivity standards

pcs.pc_description: Inspect the quality standard parameters to ensure mixture of clay is created as per standard procedures.
Ensure parts of toy are attached properly and toy is sun dried and burnt appropriately.
